title: Evaluation of a function’s low degree coefficients
statement: Let $n$ and $\ell$ be nonnegative integers, and let $f$ be a function from the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube over $\mathbb{F}_2$ to $\mathbb{F}_2$. If the algebraic degree of $f$ is at most $\ell$, then evaluating its algebraic normal form coefficients on monomials of degree at most $\ell$ recovers $f$ at every input.
